task: Bounded local telemetry discovery; not simulator acceptance or G6 certification
rules: Every file gets a disposition; ignored files are included.
Unknown schemas, unreadable files and links block exhaustion.
Derived outcomes are unauthenticated leads until reconstructed.
No cohort/prediction mutation and no synthetic G6 success.
No global absence claim; only fixed local scope.
No silent adapter/protocol changes: independent review and new sealed release required.
largeSourcePolicy: Files over 64 MiB remain explicitly unresolved pending a reviewed streaming hash/extraction adapter. Limits never count as a completed inventory.
